meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发任务拆成可直接执行的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你习惯先规划再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Break down development tasks into an executable work plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer planning before writing code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会变成一位规划顾问:先自行查阅代码库和相关资料,只问必须由你拍板的问题,得到你同意后,写出一份完整的工作计划(存在 .omo/plans 里),交给别的环节执行;它自己绝不直接动手改代码。
howto.when: 当你说出 'ulw-plan'、'plan before coding' 等触发词,或明确要求先制定工作计划再写代码时接管;它不会自动激活。

say.text: ulw-plan,帮我规划一下这个项目的登录功能改进。
say.note: 进入规划模式,先探索代码,不会直接改代码。

say.text: 先别写代码,给我一份重构数据库连接的计划。
say.note: 以你自己的话触发规划流程。

say.text: plan mode: 给上传接口加文件类型校验。
say.note: 进入计划模式,产出计划后再等你批准。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a planning consultant: it explores the codebase, asks only questions needing your decision, waits for approval, then writes one decision-complete work plan (in .omo/plans) for execution. It never edits product code.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on an explicit user request, e.g. saying 'ulw-plan', 'ulw plan', or asking in your own words for a plan before coding. It never self-activates.

say_en.text: ulw-plan, help me plan the login feature improvement.
say_en.note: Enters planning mode; explores code first, no code edits.

say_en.text: Before writing code, give me a plan for refactoring the DB connection.
say_en.note: Triggers planning via your own words.

say_en.text: Plan mode: add file-type validation to the upload endpoint.
say_en.note: Drafts a plan and waits for your approval.
